english.title: Attempted breach of sexual harm prevention order
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, attempted to do something, namely,**(..SPECIFY THING ATTEMPTED..), which you were prohibited from doing by a sexual harm prevention order made by **(..SPECIFY COURT..) under section 345 of the Sentencing Act 2020, on **(..SPECIFY DATE ORDER WAS MADE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 354(1)(a) and (4) of the Sentencing Act 2020 and section 1(1) of the Criminal Attempts Act 1981.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
without reasonable excuse
attempted to do anything prohibited by a
SHPO

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) As per section 343, this offence relates to an attempted breach of an SHPO made by the Court under section 345 of the Sentencing Act 2020.
(ii) For attempted breaches of SHPOs made under sections 103A to 103k of the Sexual Offences Act 2003, see offence H19569 / H101095.
(iii) For the version of this offence applying before 29th November 2022, see offence H22097.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Ymgais i dorri gorchymyn atal niwed rhywiol
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording: Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), heb esgus rhesymol, bu ichi geisio gwneud rhywbeth, sef,**(..SPECIFY THING ATTEMPTED..), yr oeddech wedi’ch gwahardd rhag gwneud gan orchymyn atal niwed rhywiol a wnaed gan **(..SPECIFY COURT..) dan adran 345 Deddf Dedfrydu 2020, ar **(..SPECIFY DATE ORDER WAS MADE..)
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i adran 354(1)(a) a (4) Deddf Dedfrydu 2020 ac adran 1(1) Deddf Ymgeisiau Troseddol 1981.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 5 years imprisonment.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None The maximum penalty on summary conviction may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates' court, see section 354(4)(a) of the Sentencing Act 2020. and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2022.
